title: Government Information Boundaries

source_refs.title: Regulation on the Disclosure of Government Information

originality_declaration: Original explanatory writing based on an official regulation; no third-party course material or question-bank content is included.

body.summary: Government information work balances openness with security, privacy, third-party rights, and administrative process needs. Platform content should model that balance instead of treating every public-sector document as reusable training material.
learning_points: Public access is a default policy direction, but disclosure has defined exceptions.
Sensitive categories such as state secrets, personal privacy, trade secrets, internal affairs, and process records require extra caution.
For platform content, source review should check both public availability and reuse suitability.
body.review_prompt: Before using a government source, confirm that the material is public, relevant, and not copied as a protected explanatory work.
